\chapter{Boolean Analysis --- General}
%%% generated by the blueprint pipeline from TCSlib.BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.RandomVariables.General
\section{Overview}
Independent sums preserve affine hypercontractivity, including infinite exponents. A centered variable with normalized second norm has an explicit contraction radius in terms of a higher norm.

\section{Declarations}

\begin{theorem}[Hypercontractivity of independent sums]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsHypercontractive.add_independent}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsHypercontractive, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.Tensorization.affine_sum_le}
\difficulty{5}
Let $X,Y$ be independent real random variables on a probability space. If both satisfy $H_{p,q,\rho}$, then $X+Y$ also satisfies $H_{p,q,\rho}$. Write $H_{p,q,\rho}(X)$ for $1\le p\le q\le\infty$, $0\le\rho<1$, $X\in L^q(\mu)$, and $\|a+\rho bX\|_q\le\|a+bX\|_p$ for all $a,b\in\bbr$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Hypercontractivity from a centered higher moment]
\lean{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.mean_zero_hypercontractive}
\leanok
\uses{BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsHypercontractive, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsRademacherRV, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.IsSymmetricRV, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.randomization_norm_le, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.rvLpNorm, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.rvLpNorm_affine_sq, BooleanAnalysis.Hypercontractivity.symmetric_hypercontractive}
\difficulty{7}
Let $q>2$ and let $X\in L^q$ be centered on a probability space, with $\|X\|_2=1$ and $\|X\|_q=C>0$. Then $H_{2,q,\rho}(X)$ holds for $\rho=1/(2C\sqrt{q-1})$. Write $H_{p,q,\rho}(X)$ for $1\le p\le q\le\infty$, $0\le\rho<1$, $X\in L^q(\mu)$, and $\|a+\rho bX\|_q\le\|a+bX\|_p$ for all $a,b\in\bbr$.
\end{theorem}
